themes.name: Agentic AI research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents that can autonomously perform research tasks, interact with systems, and achieve research objectives.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Articles discussing AI tools that help developers write, debug, and understand code, including code generation and review.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Content related to AI's ability to condense large amounts of text, research findings, or data into concise summaries.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Covers various AI-powered tools and platforms designed to assist researchers in their workflows, data analysis, and discovery processes.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Explores how AI is affecting jobs, employment, skills, and the broader labor market, including research into job displacement and creation.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Articles specifically about the research, development, and user interactions with AI-powered chatbots and conversational agents.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Focuses on the creation and use of AI-generated or simulated users for testing, research, and product development.

themes.name: AI tool evaluation
themes.description: Content that compares, reviews, or assesses the effectiveness and performance of different AI tools and platforms.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Examines how AI is being integrated into design processes, systems, and user research methodologies.

themes.name: AI customer insights
themes.description: Covers AI's role in analyzing customer data, feedback, and behavior to generate actionable insights for businesses.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
